message: cad_export_body requires a NativeCAD licence key — this server is running unlicensed. An unlicensed server models, measures and checks freely; what it will not do is put the geometry anywhere you keep it (export, save/restore, import, mesh payloads, quoting).

details.evalHint: modelling, query, DFM and cad_evaluate all work without a key — only taking the geometry off this machine needs one
details.contestHint: cad_contest start with a contest ticket opens the modelling tools for a contest build
